lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Enclave 7, 2312. Housing block, allocation office, a bench you ate lunch on for eleven years. Forty thousand people on the shelf of ground above what used to be Port Halden.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I filed from that third window. Every quarter for eleven years, and every quarter it closed.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Four days after I asked who Continuity Holdings were, my card stopped working on that door. Nobody came to explain. Nobody had to. The access list is allocation, and allocation is not a person you can argue with.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing here is ruined. Nothing here is even unpleasant. It is simply all decided, and you have now been standing in the rooms where the deciding was done.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: So this is where you grew up. It is very clean.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: I do not mean that unkindly. I mean I have been here an hour and I have not seen one thing anybody chose.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two Wardens at the block entrance are logging faces as people pass. One of them is taking noticeably longer over yours than the other.
